explicit_current_observation_install_pyt:
# Run only after reviewing the newly created observation; writers remain paused.
# Invocation: python3 -B - "$checkpoint_dir" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, os, sys
root = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / ".noeaaeue/scripts"))
import check_math_layout as layout
import source_observations
checkpoint = Path(sys.argv[1])
current_name = ".noeaaeue/bindings/current-source-observations.json"
previous = layout.read_regular(root, str(checkpoint / "current-source-observations.previous.json"))
new_raw = layout.read_regular(root, str(checkpoint / "current-source-observations.new.json"))
expected = source_observations.create(root, layout.read_regular,
    layout.git_inventory(root)["paths"], layout.source_role, layout.imports)
if json.loads(new_raw) != expected:
    raise SystemExit("new observation drifted; preserve it and create another explicit observation")
if layout.read_regular(root, current_name) != previous:
    raise SystemExit("current pointer changed; preserve both versions and reconcile the collision")
current = root / current_name
temporary = current.with_name("current-source-observations." + checkpoint.name + ".new")
with temporary.open("xb") as stream:
    stream.write(new_raw)
if layout.read_regular(root, current_name) != previous:
    raise SystemExit("current pointer changed before installation; temporary copy retained")
os.replace(temporary, current)
# PY
